steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2025, Equity Mates cited Telstra’s incredible market share and profitability when discussing the checklist’s first step, framing it as a dominant Australian telco that many people use.

episode.title: Bryce is turning $500-to-$5,000, DeepSeek freak out & our 4-point stock checklist

views.text: In January 2025, Equity Mates compared Starlink to Australian telcos and said regional service from Telstra and local telcos often sucked, noting Telstra had 22.5 million customers and a $70 plan while Starlink charged about $139 a month in Australia.

episode.title: We're back for 2025: Stock of the Year & Bold Predictions

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In January 2025, Equity Mates said Telstra would likely grow at GDP plus a little, arguing it wasn’t the long‑term compounder they sought, despite its dominance.

episode.title: Bryce is turning $500-to-$5,000, DeepSeek freak out & our 4-point stock checklist

views.text: In September 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Telstra as a very mature business that generally didn’t grow earnings much, noting a 10% earnings lift last year came from mobile price increases and questioning the sustainability of dividends funded beyond cash flow.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Michael Gable - Gold, Paladin Energy, Goodman Group, BHP & more

views.text: In September 2021, a guest on Equity Mates contrasted Apple’s growth with Telstra’s more mature, income‑style profile, saying Telstra had followed the same model for years rather than pursuing high growth.

episode.title: Talk Money To Me | Meet Candice and Felicity

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In January 2025, Equity Mates criticised Telstra’s reinvestment track record, saying its big new initiatives and M&A history weren’t pretty, which weighed on how they viewed management’s capital allocation.

episode.title: Bryce is turning $500-to-$5,000, DeepSeek freak out & our 4-point stock checklist

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates discussed Telstra’s Digicel Pacific deal, highlighting the government‑backed structure where Telstra put in $270 million for a business generating $233 million of free cash flow, and noted the market reacted favourably.

episode.title: Weaponising Corporate Power in the Pacific

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In September 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said at around $4 the share price could struggle, arguing Telstra’s mature profile, limited growth and dividends not wholly funded by cash flow made the valuation look stretched.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Michael Gable - Gold, Paladin Energy, Goodman Group, BHP & more
